sources: native rollout metadata for seven bound actors

findings.observed: Three bounded implementation/test children admitted together; replacement acceptance plus two reviewers and a research child added; root authored shared contracts while server, web and tests overlapped. All non-root actors were direct children.
findings.impact: Useful independent progress with one integration owner; no demonstrated need for deeper subtree ownership.
findings.proposed_action: Retain bounded parallel frontier and measure integrated useful work rather than admission count.
findings.validation: Compare accepted commits and root integration timing against child active intervals.

findings.proposed_action: Reproduce exact window-index collision and verify process cleanup receipts before resource reuse.

findings.validation: In next similar wave, count question-to-answer continuations versus Blocked/reissue and integrated output.

findings.operation: request update admission, presentation and reply fence
evidence: actor 2 rollout 02:50:41 call_5rvtZlTBlSgIjLu9Uz2EJ9GP; 02:51:05 call_dalyrz1A7OBgljcdFDD4egyh; 02:51:17 call_C3PworW5schnU0A7hW6DXuSP; exact inbox row 8 payload in native user message 03:00:33.168, host reconciliation 03:00:33.874
findings.observed: Update was durably queued and remained unpresented through the 02:53:28 audit cutoff. Two repeated candidate replies were refused by the correct update fence. The 02:51:17 sessionInput inspection did not prove presentation of this update; exact native presentation occurred at 03:00:33.168, followed by host reconciliation. Further base correction was sent before cutoff; no checked incorporation of either correction is established by that cutoff.
findings.hypothesis: Earlier tracked native inputs and active recipient turns delayed this update until a later idle dispatch boundary.
findings.confidence: high for exact inbox-to-native presentation and reply refusals; incorporation unverified
findings.impact: Duplicate tool calls and delayed candidate settlement while correctness fence held.
findings.proposed_action: Keep pending-update state salient until exact presentation; tell recipients to end their turn and await the update rather than repeat the same reply, because older queued inputs may take multiple boundaries. Preserve the reply fence.
findings.validation: Controlled ordered-backlog update/reply test proves refusals until exact presentation, followed by checked incorporation and the candidate reply.

findings.operation: settlement event routing and response reads
evidence: root rollout 14 Haskell cells / 17 pollResponse expressions through 02:49:40
findings.observed: Every sampled root pollResponse returned Ready or Unavailable; no empty poll was observed. Host queued 17 notices behind native delivery while root continued work.
findings.hypothesis: Native input presentation delayed notices while the provider was busy; exact causal contribution to root latency is not measured.
findings.confidence: high for counts; medium for latency mechanism
findings.impact: Event results remained recoverable, but notification presentation lagged.
findings.proposed_action: Measure notice accepted-to-presented latency and preserve event-driven reads.
findings.validation: Trace per-notice enqueue/present/recover time under active provider turn.

findings.observed: 292.049 s cell; 83.835 s compiler preflight wait preceded stale reservation; fallback held machine 165.405 s. Compiler response 130.828 s was nested inside hold.
findings.hypothesis: Exact compile-view field causing staleness is unrecorded; nearby actor activity is not established as cause.
findings.confidence: high for call path and timings; low for stale-field cause
findings.impact: Shared machine unavailable during long fallback; timing summary compile_ms undercounts work inside checkout.
findings.proposed_action: Use stale-field diagnostic 56aff5819 in a later run, then repair only proven stale predicate or fallback strategy.
findings.validation: Reproduce field and run focused concurrent split test with checkout-hold timing.

findings.observed: Real-binary browser journey was integrated as an expected-red gate and corrected through later contract revisions. Server tip bac176e still had an older base than integrated root at cutoff; root was preflighting rather than claiming final server acceptance.
findings.impact: Consumer test exposed missing durable correlated outcome while avoiding false green.
findings.proposed_action: Incorporate current root base, run focused server and browser tests on one exact revision, then review.
findings.validation: Expected count and executed count plus actual browser journey on integrated binary.
